description: The element that owns the connection — a composition in ARXML, the enclosing part or package in SysML v2. Deliberately NOT containment: Connection is not an Element, so Ownership cannot carry this, and the objection to making Connection ownable is specifically about creating a second *containment* path. A non-containment relation raises no such conflict, and anchoring it at the Connection node mirrors how ConnectionSource/ConnectionTarget already do (docs/coreSpecs/RiaViews.md).
